create.name: Phoebe Garnsworthy
create.bio:
Phoebe Garnsworthy is an Australian author, meditation teacher and energy healer who has made her home on Ibiza. After a decade of travel spent learning from spiritual teachers, healers and old philosophical texts, she began writing about the everyday magic she found in spiritual practice, and her books now take in non-fiction, poetry and magical-realist novels. Among them are Daily Rituals, Align with Soul, Remember the Witch Within, She Who Holds The Moon and I Affirm My Power, the last published by Andrews McMeel.

Her guided meditations, released weekly on YouTube and also on Insight Timer, blend spiritual philosophy with visualisation and usually end on an affirmation. Recurring themes are trusting your life path, spirit guides, angels, moon rituals, manifestation and protecting your energy. For those who want more structure she runs short online e-courses built around a video, journaling and a meditation each day. On Ibiza she works in person as a certified sound healer and Reiki practitioner, offering Reiki, singing-bowl sessions, private meditations and house blessings, and she writes openly about white witchcraft and her own rituals.

books.title: Daily Rituals: Positive Affirmations to Attract Love, Happiness and Peace
books.author: Phoebe Garnsworthy
books.description: A short book of affirmations and simple rituals built on the idea that everything is energy, so the feelings you practise shape what comes towards you. It is meant to be dipped into day by day.

books.title: Align with Soul: a spiritual guide to transform your life
books.author: Phoebe Garnsworthy
books.description: Her longest guide to spiritual living, setting out philosophy, tools and techniques for meeting life's challenges as chances to grow and for building a closer bond with the soul.

books.title: I Affirm My Power: Everyday Affirmations and Rituals to Create the Life That You Desire
books.author: Phoebe Garnsworthy
books.description: An illustrated book from Andrews McMeel combining affirmations, small daily rituals, journaling and meditation as a way to make room for self-care and connection with the soul.

books.title: Remember the Witch Within: magical studies of our past lives
books.author: Phoebe Garnsworthy
books.description: Seven chapters recounting past lives she explored through hypnotic regression, used to reflect on the suppressed history of witches and the feminine wisdom carried down the generations.

books.title: She Who Holds The Moon: Spiritual Poetry For Women Remembering Their Magic
books.author: Phoebe Garnsworthy
books.description: A poetry collection arranged in three movements, unravelling, becoming and rising, written for women learning to trust themselves and reclaim a sense of inner magic.

books.title: When You Need A Reminder Of How Loved You Are: a nurturing book to motivate and inspire
books.author: Phoebe Garnsworthy
books.description: A gentle book of encouragement on self-love, letting go of old beliefs and finding strength after hard times, written to be opened whenever you need reassurance.

courses.title: Energy Healing Sessions on Ibiza (Reiki, sound and ritual)
courses.description: In-person sessions on Ibiza, including Reiki, singing-bowl sound baths, a combined sound-and-Reiki session, private meditations made for you, and house cleansing and blessing. Bookings are by enquiry.

courses.title: Loving the Life You Lead – 7 Day Ecourse
courses.description: A week-long online introduction to spiritual living, covering self-love, boundaries and caring for your energy. Each day brings a short video, a mantra, journaling prompts and a guided meditation.

courses.title: Stepping into Your Power – 7 Day Ecourse
courses.description: A follow-on course for those already familiar with spiritual ideas, teaching how to build personal rituals for manifestation and for sensing the aura and unseen realms. It includes six meditations, nine rituals and guidance sheets.

courses.title: Harnessing Universal Energy To Transform Your Life
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course of about fifteen minutes a day, working in turn with earth, air, water, fire and spirit. It offers meditations and simple exercises for grounding, clearing and recharging your energy.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Phoebe Garnsworthy on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer page has free guided meditations on trusting the universe, moon manifestation, surrender and finding answers within, most ending with an affirmation. They are free to play.

free_resources.title: How to Create a Spiritual Life – free 3-day ecourse
free_resources.description: A free three-day email course: each day brings a meditation and a video on one of her favourite practices for listening to and caring for the soul, about half an hour a day.
